## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001620246754858718**. This is +9.97e-8 over PR604 (0.001620147045734211). The conservative model gives 0.001620246751982763.

This PR is DreamingOfClouds' PR604 (`complex-571-cold14`: 14 cold factory-scratch helpers per call ending at 4-dimensional frames, on our PR601 witness) with an **improved literal owner map only**. Dispatch is unchanged: ck ×44, atm3 ×22, jp8 ×6. A depth-2 ejection-chain polish of PR604's map changes the idle remainders, which the concave moment cost rewards. Against PR604's package, only `data/OWNERS.json.gz`, `data/PLAN.json` (windows and profile) and `data/SPEC.json` (expected values) differ. All construction code, `cold_end` and every other step, controls, proofs and the verifier are PR604's, byte for byte. The package directory is renamed `complex-571-cold14-j1` so it doesn't collide with PR604's, and README, NOTICE and `verify.sh` name it accordingly.

All of PR604's soundness argument applies unchanged: Lean via #593/#599 (`hpe_word_multi`, `exact_cold`), exact (N) checks for every (0, U_b) pair, the guarded refactored cleanup, and wrapper-order enforcement. An owner map only changes which helper sits in which owner slot. PR604's strict physical owner audit, invoice and assembly re-check that from scratch.

## Verification

```sh
research/complex-571-cold14-j1/verify.sh /tmp/complex-571-cold14-j1 ..   # SOURCE_ROOT holds worktrees pr568 pr569 pr571 pr575 pr583 at the pinned commits
```

Local result (Windows, CPython 3.11.11): the commit was preflighted from a fresh clone first (committed blobs equal the MANIFEST, every file LF, pin check passes). The official run from that clean clone of `ddd81bc` then gave `PASS_COLD14_NATIVE_COMPLEX_AND_CITED_BIT`, κ 0.001620246754858718, 55/55 stages exit 0, 478 s, with no reused baseline or locals. The receipt records MANIFEST sha256 d3196098…, equal to the committed MANIFEST.

GitHub CI has not run, and I make no claim about it.

## Declarative inputs

Unlike our PR591–PR603, this package doesn't yet ship `data/WITNESS.json`, `data/EXPECTED.json` or `data/cand.json`, because our witness tools don't yet support PR604's `cold_end` step. Those files will follow as a separate commit on this PR, after their own official verify.

## Credits

- **DreamingOfClouds**: PR604 (the cold-ended construction, `cold_end`, verifier changes and package), PR599, PR509 and PR516 (Lean).
- **jeremykothe2**: PR601, PR600, PR596, PR593, PR592 and PR591 (the hyperplane-end base), and this owner map.
- The pinned PR568, PR569, PR571, PR575 and PR583 packages and all earlier contributors are listed in NOTICE.md.

**AI disclosure and authorship:** Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), running in the omp coding harness, found this owner map and prepared the PR. Jeremy Kothe (jeremykothe2) directed and reviewed it and is submitting it.

## Scope

The result is conditional on the inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape/exact recovery, analytic transfer and the bit H1–H5 assumptions. It inherits PR604's draft status: PR604's own heavy verification was still running when this was opened. It is finite exact evidence, not an unconditional theorem, a complete Lean proof, or a practical speedup.
